caption: The drawing depicts six side views of the same ornate, hemispherical bowl, arranged in a grid with three rows and two columns. The upper left image is a light gray line drawing, showing detailed ornamentation composed of circular and curved patterns. The upper right image shows the same bowl shaded in a uniform tan or light brown tone, highlighting the circular and wavy designs. The middle left image presents a more detailed depiction in brown tones, emphasizing the texture and shadows of the relief decorations. The middle right bowl appears darker with higher contrast, further emphasizing the three-dimensional carved patterns. The bottom left version introduces greenish tones along with brown, suggesting weathering or patina over carved decorations. The bottom right bowl similarly uses dark brown and greenish patina, with the carved designs appearing textured and weathered. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the images are evenly spaced on the page, with the artist's name, "RAYMONDE F. LÉVY," written at the lower right corner.
title: Technique Demo (Architectural Detail)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
